about_the_game:
Wicked House is a romantic and mysterious adventure about a young woman who must survive 5 days in a haunted house to earn her freedom.

Trapped in a suspiciously arranged marriage with a questionable man. Her only way out is to accept a desperate deal: spend five days in a haunted house and claim the property as her own. An offer that seems too good to be true… but could also be her ticket to freedom.

You play as a poor beggar girl from a forgotten village, in a world where magic and monsters still exist. Inside the house, you soon discover you are not alone: a mysterious ghost boy roams the halls. He doesn’t even remember his own name… will he be an ally, or a threat?

To survive, you must explore the house, solve puzzles, and uncover its secrets, while learning that even broken souls can change… and find love.

Mysterious Ghost Boy:

He lives in the house, but doesn’t even remember his own name. Despite being a ghost, he is a coward at heart.

Eccentric Lawyer:

A strange lawyer who has just moved near your village. He offers a deal no one has ever dared to accept… until now. What is he really hiding?

Features

  • Explore the house: Discover its secrets, wander through its rooms, and uncover hidden clues.

  • Unravel the mystery: Solve puzzles, complete sequences, and make choices to progress in the story.

  • Meaningful choices: Face decisions that will determine the ending of your love story.

  • Immersive story: Dive into this romance where you see no good or evil, only survival and the consequences of your choices.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains non-explicit sexual content
